availability_evidence: https://investors.computacenter.com/news-releases/news-release-details/computacenter-final-results-2021 — issuer-dated primary full-year results PDF published 16 March 2022
observation: Supply-chain constraints and customer-order delays were widespread; France organic revenue declined 6.6% and adjusted operating profit fell 70.8%, while North American Services margin fell 592bps. The Group also disclosed that it would no longer retain a dedicated Spanish sales team, which is excluded as already announced. At Group level revenue increased 23.6%, adjusted profit before tax increased 27.5%, adjusted net funds rose to £241.4m and net funds to £95.3m, while operating cash inflow remained strong at £224.3m.
already_announced_exclusion: The decision to stop operating a dedicated Spanish sales team was already disclosed in the source and is excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Multiple contained segment and supply-chain pressures were outweighed at Group level by strong revenue and profit growth, strong operating cash flow and higher net funds; the disclosed Spanish sales-footprint decision is excluded.
